clips.title: The story
paras: Sputtervalve is a stressed goblin engineer stationed in the port town of Ratchet. Serving the Tinkers' Union under Director Riddlevox, he oversees regional shredder research and development under crushing corporate deadlines. To keep his standing, he frequently hires adventurers to engage in industrial espionage against the rival Venture Company.

Operating out of Ratchet, Sputtervalve answers to Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union. Put in charge of shredder development, he quickly discovered that keeping pace with modern mechanization is brutal work. Facing fierce competition and an unforgiving deadline, Sputtervalve found himself with few working prototypes of his own. Rather than admit failure to the Union, he turned toward the classic goblin solution: stealing better designs from whoever built them first.

Sputtervalve's primary target is the Venture Company's drilling operation at the Sludge Fen to the northwest. Their latest shredder models boast interchangeable hands, refined control grips, and advanced internal mechanisms like the elusive samophlange. Desperate to crack their secrets, Sputtervalve dispatched his associate Wizzlecrank into the Fen for 'field research,' only for the operative to get trapped, forcing Sputtervalve to hire wandering mercenaries to recover stolen technology and rescue his partner.

Beyond his shredder dilemmas, Sputtervalve acts as a general point of contact for strange curiosities passing through the Barrens. When adventurers drag bizarre, corrupter-infused artifacts out of the Wailing Caverns—such as a glowing shard—Sputtervalve knows enough about the local landscape to direct them away from gadgetry and toward the isolated druids encamped above the caverns.
